overall_assessment: Where sections are extracted, the section split is good: learning outcomes, arbeidskrav and assessment land correctly and the leak-> flags are false alarms. The main defect is that the 4th-year/praksis course family (M5GP*) yields no sections at all although the headings were read and mapped. Smaller issues are stray ';' separators, an unmapped 'Fagets arbeids- og undervisningsformer' heading, and one admission sentence in prerequisites.

findings.description: All Praksis courses (M5GP1000/2000/4000/4200, 0 stp, 4 of 17 packet courses, 5 of 5 pre-pass 'no sections' suspects) have zero rows in plan_sections, although the heading list shows the page was read and Forkunnskapskrav, Læringsutbytte, Innhold, Arbeids- og undervisningsformer, Arbeidskrav og obligatoriske aktiviteter and Vurdering og eksamen all mapped to canonical sections. Learning outcomes, content, teaching methods, coursework requirements and assessment are all present in the plan but none is emitted.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Headings are mapped, so the failure is after sectionize(): probably .clean_sections() or a placeholder/length filter discarding the sections (these plans have no Pensum and the emneplan part is mostly 'Se fagplanen' stubs and the fagplan has repeated KUNNSKAP/FERDIGHETER/GENERELL KOMPETANSE sub-headings per year, so learning_outcomes may be dropped as duplicate or oversized), or a fagplan-year-specific sub-heading collision.
findings.suggested_fix: Debug sectionize() for M5GP4000-1 interactively with tar_make(callr_function = NULL) and find which step empties the table. Then fix the filter. Add a regression test with a Praksis fixture. If no usable text exists in the emneplan part, emit the fagplan Innledning/Organisering as course_content instead of nothing.

findings.description: Stray ';' characters are inserted inside sentences or at the end of lines/paragraphs (e.g. 'relevante teoriar for; munnleg; opplæring', 'litterære;tema', 'Ved ny/utsatt eksamen:;Individuell', 'masteroppgaven og framtidige lærerarbeid.;'). The same courses in other years (MGVM4100 2023 and 2020) do not have them, so the noise comes from the harvested HTML rather than the plan. The text is polluted and word-level analysis (e.g. 'for;' tokens) is affected.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Inline elements (span/br/nbsp or hidden separators) in the OsloMet EPN-V2 HTML are joined with ';' somewhere in the block reader or text extraction (R/blocks.R / R/extract_fulltext.R), probably only for a subset of crawl dates.
findings.suggested_fix: Inspect the raw HTML of these two courses to find the source of ';'. Strip a ';' that is directly adjacent to a word boundary or at end of line in the OsloMet reader, or fix the join separator in the block reader.

findings.description: In the many courses whose emneplan says 'Se fagplanen' under Arbeids- og undervisningsformer, the real description sits under the fagplan sub-heading 'Fagets arbeids- og undervisningsformer', which is unmapped, so teaching_methods is empty for MGPE3300, M5GSF2110, M1GSF2100, M5GKP2100 and others. Similar fagplan sub-headings with substantive content ('Vurderings-/eksamensformer', 'Fagets innhold og oppbygging') are also unmapped and their text is lost.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/section_heading_map.R has no pattern for 'Fagets arbeids- og undervisningsformer' (it probably only matches 'Arbeids- og undervisningsformer' at line start) and no pattern for 'Fagets innhold og oppbygging' / 'Vurderings-/eksamensformer'.
findings.suggested_fix: Add patterns (optionally prefixed 'Fagets ') to R/section_heading_map.R: '^Fagets arbeids- og undervisningsformer' -> teaching_methods, '^Vurderings-/?eksamensformer' -> assessment. Check the effect on assessment with tar_make and metrics_check.

findings.evidence: Emnet er en innføring i det å være lærer i kroppsøving på 5.-10. trinn i grunnskolen.
findings.description: learning_outcomes starts with two paragraphs of course description (the intro that follows the 'Læringsutbytte' heading in the fagplan part) before 'Etter fullført emne har studenten ...'. That text is course_content by the codebook, not a learning outcome. The same fagplan 'Læringsutbytte' sub-heading is picked up in courses 8-14 too, but only here does it carry description text.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The fagplan sub-heading 'Læringsutbytte' (sub) and the emneplan 'Læringsutbytte' are both mapped to learning_outcomes and concatenated, with intro paragraphs of the fagplan LO block included.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() for OsloMet, cut learning_outcomes at the first line starting 'Etter fullført emne har studenten', and move the preceding paragraphs to course_content (or drop them).

findings.evidence: Eksterne søkere må ha bestått lærerutdanning som kvalifiserer for arbeid i skolen.
findings.description: MGMH2100 prerequisites contains only an admission requirement for external applicants (Opptakskrav text; 'Opptakskrav' itself is mapped to .drop), not a prerequisite. M1KP4200 prerequisites is the pointer 'Se programplanen for informasjon om eventuelle forkunnskapskrav og progresjonskrav.' and contains no content. Both are admission or placeholder text rather than substantive prerequisites.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The first sentence of the Opptakskrav block is dropped with the heading, but the following paragraph is attached to the next mapped heading (Forkunnskapskrav), or the emneplan Forkunnskapskrav was missing in the older page. No placeholder filter for 'Se programplanen' exists for prerequisites.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop prerequisites that match '^Se (programplanen|fagplanen)' and treat 'Eksterne søkere' paragraphs after a dropped Opptakskrav heading as part of .drop.

findings.description: coursework_requirements consists only of the placeholder 'Ingen arbeidskrav.' (flagged short; this is a real statement, but a row is emitted with no content). Prerequisites, content and some teaching_methods sections elsewhere carry the similar stubs 'Se fagplanen.' / 'Se programplanen.', e.g. course_content in M5GSF2110 starts with 'Se fagplanen.'.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: No placeholder filter for 'Ingen ...' / 'Se fagplanen' stubs in .clean_sections().
findings.suggested_fix: Treat '^Ingen( arbeidskrav)?\.?$' and '^Se (fag|program)planen\.?$' as empty and drop them, or keep them consistently and document it. The pre-pass 'short' flag is a false alarm for this reason.

findings.description: Dashes in the source are replaced by the character '¿' (several lines) and the section opens with an unbalanced quote 'Fordypningstema - spesialpedagogikk»'. This is an encoding defect from the source page or harvest, not a sectioning error.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Character encoding conversion of the source HTML (cp1252 en dash read as unknown).
findings.suggested_fix: Check the encoding of the raw HTML; map '¿' to an en dash in text cleanup for OsloMet if the raw page really contains it.
